recent_en: RT Pastry announced the acquisition of industrial land and a factory in Seri Kembangan for RM22.00 million, and accepted RM28.78 million in banking facilities from RHB Islamic Bank. The company also declared an interim single-tier dividend of RM0.006 per share, with an ex-date of 9 December 2026. Its IPO was oversubscribed 6.4 times ahead of its ACE Market listing.
notable_en: Proposed cash acquisition of industrial land and a single-storey detached factory with a three-storey office in Seri Kembangan for RM22.00 million.
Acceptance of RM28.78 million in banking facilities from RHB Islamic Bank, partly to finance the proposed acquisition.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of RM0.006 per share, ex-date 9 December 2026, payment date 24 December 2026.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM14,535,000, net income was RM3,000, and net margin was 0.0%.
